sections.text_helper: Section 9.3.3 "RTC domain reset" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 253.
sections.section_content:
The RTC domain has two specific resets, generated when one of the following events
occurs:
• A software reset, is triggered by setting the RTCDRST bit in RCC_RTCCR. Write
access to this domain must be enabled before setting RTCDRST bit to perform the
reset.
• A VDD power on
An RTC domain reset affects the LSE oscillator, the RTC, the backup registers, and the
RCC_RTCCR register.
